latency_definition: Each sample is the maximum of eight rank-local full-dispatch CUDA-event durations, in microseconds. Each round has five untimed warmups and twenty measured samples per T.
token_scope: T is the input token count per GPU. No extra world-size factor.
publication_note: Only workload configuration and timing samples are exported. Machine identities, network information, paths, raw logs, binary snapshots and traces are not distributed.
